The '''Light of Truth''' is an inn in [[Sienda]] run by Mistress [[Jharen]].

It is, as the name might suggest, frequented by [[Children of the Light]].

==Activities==
[[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] stay here on their journey from [[Tanchico]]. They meet [[Galad Damodred]] over breakfast in the common room.
